sources_used: zenius-i-vanisher.com (ZIv arcade pages for all sids)
pinup / UWDDR community notes (ZIv + Facebook mentions)

findings.name: Most Wanted Pawn
findings.evidence_quote: Pawn Shop that both sells you and buys your video games... Has an arcade machine too. Games listed: Spider-Man: The Video Game; Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3; War Final Assault. No music games.
findings.note: New Glasgow NS pawn with a few free-play classics. Inventory is non-rhythm; ZIv music section empty. Store still open per mostwantedpawn.com.

findings.name: Most Wanted Pawn
findings.evidence_quote: Games: The Simpsons Arcade Game; Virtua Fighter 4 Evolution; Asteroids. No music games listed.
findings.note: Truro NS pawn location. Classic cabinets only on ZIv; no rhythm evidence found elsewhere.

findings.name: Méga Parc
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade at the theme park is much smaller than its predecessor... consists mostly of kiddie games... Games inventory (updated 2026-07-10) is FEC/redemption/racing/shooters only (World's Largest Pac-Man, Jurassic Park Arcade, Time Crisis 5, Grand Piano Keys ticket game, etc.). No Music Game entries.
findings.note: Galeries de la Capitale indoor park, Québec City. Grand Piano Keys is a ticket redemption piano, not a tracked rhythm title. Recent ZIv inventory supports no Bemani/ITG/GH.

findings.name: New Play
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: In the Groove 2 (North America) Location: New Play large arcade near London Drugs... Comment: Modded r23 with no customs... As of 2024... Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Location: New Play at Galaxyland... There are two New Play arcades in the mall... In The Groove 2 with added songs is available... The other New Play is located within Galaxyland. DDR SuperNOVA is available for play.
findings.note: West Edmonton Mall Playdium/New Play. Tracked as other (ITG2 + Guitar Hero Arcade). Info block also claims DDR SuperNOVA at Galaxyland New Play, but DDR is not on the current Music Games table; treat ddr as unverified until reconfirmed. Yelp also mentions Guitar Hero Arcade.

findings.name: Niagara Falls Fun Zone
findings.evidence_quote: Games listed: Multicade; Batman; Dead Heat Riders; Hummer Extreme; Initial D Arcade Stage 4; NASCAR Racing; Need for Speed Carbon; Sno Cross; Aliens Armageddon; Razing Storm. No music games.
findings.note: Fallsview tourist arcade + laser tag. Inventory is racing/shooters; no rhythm cabs on ZIv.

findings.name: Olympia Bowl Hawkesbury
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs/notes: Claw Machine; Sega Rally 2 Championship. No music games.
findings.note: Small bowling alley. Only claw + racing on ZIv; no rhythm evidence found.

findings.name: Orleans Bowling Centre - OBC
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Jurassic Park (Stern); Ms. Pac-Man; Stacker; Star Wars (Stern). No music games.
findings.note: Orleans/Ottawa bowling. Pinball + classic/redemption only on ZIv.

findings.name: Pin Up Arcade Bar
findings.evidence_quote: Has a DDR cabinet converted to ITG. Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet... Recently upgraded from DDR SN2 to ITG once the PC blew. Running Simply Love on Stepmania 5.3 Outfox with 4000+ songs.
findings.note: Waterloo barcade still open (Instagram/Yelp 2026). Not commercial StepManiaX hardware; StepMania/ITG pad cab maps to other. Informal Facebook mentions of DDR refer to this pad cabinet.

findings.name: PinBar
findings.evidence_quote: Laidback Retro Barcade with Pinball in Calgary. Games inventory is pinball (AC/DC, Aerosmith, Medieval Madness, etc.) plus Golden Axe, Marvel Super Heroes, Street Fighter Alpha, Pac-Man Battle Royale, Big Buck Hunter, Hit the Ice, NBA Jam, NFL Blitz. No Music Game entries.
findings.note: pinbaryyc.com brands as Calgary's first Pinball & Arcade Bar. No rhythm titles in ZIv list or site marketing. ZIv list aged 2020; still no public reports of DDR/maimai/ITG here.

findings.name: Place Biermans
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Comment: Green and red buttons do not work, you feel scammed playing 1 song for 1.25$ when the controller does not work.
findings.note: Shawinigan QC. GH Arcade present but broken per 2025 visit. ZIv also has a picture titled Dance Dance Revolution EXTREME not listed in current games; do not count ddr without confirmation it is still on floor.

findings.name: Planet Laser
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade Action Awaits at Planet Laser... redemption games... gallery shows racing (motors/drift), basketball, Fast & Furious, Tower of Tickets. No named rhythm or music cabinets.
findings.note: Oakville laser tag + arcade. ZIv has empty notes. Photos suggest FEC/racing; no full public game list. Cannot confirm or deny rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Planet Lazer
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Crazy Tower; Injustice Arcade; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015) Deluxe Motion 55"; NERF: Arcade; Tower of Tickets; Willy Crash. No music games.
findings.note: Kelowna laser tag FEC lineup; no rhythm titles on ZIv.

findings.name: Playtime Bowl & Entertainment
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Big Bass Wheel; Connect 4 Hoops; Crazy Curves; Extreme Hoops; Fire Storm; Ice Ball FX; Lane Master XTREME; Lord of Rings (LE); Monster Drop; Pirates Hook; Raccoon Rampage; Sailor's Quest VR; Super Bikes 3; Taj Mahal Mini; The Walking Dead; Ticket Dome; To Tha Net; Toilet Bowl Toss; Tower of Tickets; Wild West Shootout. No music games.
findings.note: Toronto bowling FEC/redemption list only.

findings.name: Pony Boat Social Club
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade. Beep boop. A retro selection including Pinball, Space Invaders, Guitar Hero, Big Buck Hunter, Air Hockey, Skeeball, and tons more!
findings.note: Charlottetown PE adult arcade/bar. Venue site currently lists Guitar Hero among arcade games. ZIv (2023) also logged Guitar Hero Arcade. Maps to other.

findings.name: Pop Topic
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Avengers Infinity Quest; Fantastic Prize; Marvel vs. Capcom: Clash of Super Heroes. No music games.
findings.note: Brampton collectibles shop with a few arcade/pinball machines (poptopic.shop still active). No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Propeller Brewing Company
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Atlantis; Dig Dug; Guardians of the Galaxy (Pro/Premium/LE); Hit the Ice; NARC; Skateball. No music games.
findings.note: Halifax brewery barcade: pinball + classics only.

findings.name: Putting Edge
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Air FX; Basketball Machine; Big Bass Wheel; Deal or No Deal; GRID (Twin Cab 2P); Hockey Table; Ice Ball; Pirates Hook; Platinum Heights; Whack N Win!; Wheel of Fortune. No music games.
findings.note: Halifax glow mini-golf + FEC chain. Same pattern as other Putting Edge sites: no current rhythm.

findings.name: Putting Edge Montréal
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Aliens Armageddon; Cruis'n Blast; Extreme Hoops; Hockey Table. No music games.
findings.note: Short FEC/racing list; no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Putting Edge Ottawa
findings.evidence_quote: There used to be a DDR Extreme machine there in the early 2010s. Current games: Cruis'n Blast; Jurassic Park Arcade; Big Bass Wheel; Dizzy Chicken; Down The Clown; Flappy Tickets; Platinum Heights; Pop The Lock; Slam-A-Winner; Whack N Win!; Basketball Machine; Air FX. No music games currently listed.
findings.note: Positive historical note that DDR Extreme was removed years ago. Remaining inventory is FEC only. ZIv aged 2019; no newer reports of music games returning.

findings.name: Retro
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Aero Fighters; Badlands; Cue Ball Wizard; Elvis; Golden Tee '97; Millipede; Mortal Kombat; Ms. Pac-Man; Sports Shooting USA; TETRIS; The Addams Family; The King of Fighters Neowave. No music games.
findings.note: Corner Brook NL retro barcade. Classic/fighter/pinball only.

findings.name: Retro Oasis Escape Rooms and Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: 1942; Bubble Bobble; BurgerTime; Centipede; Columns; Donkey Kong; Double Dragon; Frogger; Galaga; Gauntlet; Ms. Pac-Man; Street Fighter II; Sunset Riders; Superman; Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles; Tekken 2; The Simpsons Arcade Game; WWF Wrestlefest; Zaxxon. No music games. Site: Come visit our retro 80's and 90's arcade with over 20 machines!
findings.note: Okotoks AB still open (retrooasis.ca). Pure retro classics/pinball; no modern rhythm titles in public inventory.

findings.name: Richmond Hill Pro Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Batman; Capcom Bowling; Dirty Drivin'; Freddy A Nightmare on Elm Street; Ice Ball; Let's Go Jungle; Police Force; Sea Wolf II; Star Wars: Racer Arcade. No music games.
findings.note: Bowling arcade mix without rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Riptide Lagoon
findings.evidence_quote: Our family fun activities include miniature golf, arcade and laser bumper cars.
findings.note: Parksville BC seasonal mini-golf park with an unnamed arcade. ZIv notes empty; no public machine list. Cannot confirm rhythm presence or absence.

findings.name: Rival Axe Throwing
findings.evidence_quote: Experience the thrill of axe throwing, challenge your friends to a game of cornhole or darts... Facebook: play a game of pool, darts, cornhole, arcade games.
findings.note: Airdrie AB axe venue. Mentions generic arcade games but no inventory. Not enough to claim confirmed_none or has_games.

findings.name: Rogers Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Arcade Legends 2; Avengers Infinity Quest; Extreme Shot; Hot Wheels (American Pinball); Ms. Pac-Man/Galaga: 20 Year Reunion; Pac-Man's Pixel Bash; Star Wars (Stern); Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (Stern). No music games.
findings.note: Toronto Blue Jays ballpark Outfield District / WestJet Flight Deck amusement area. Pinball and classics only on ZIv.

findings.name: Scooter's Roller Palace
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: ATV Track; Arm Champs II; Cruis'n World; Silent Scope 2: Dark Silhouette; Virtua Cop 3; ultracade Multi-Game System. No music games.
findings.note: Mississauga roller rink arcade. No rhythm titles listed.

findings.name: SilverCity Newmarket Cinemas and Xscape Entertainment Centre
findings.evidence_quote: This SilverCity and Xscape combined location has a history of dance machines... leaving this arcade with one ITG2 running Simply Love with custom songs. Music Game: In the Groove 2... Running custom Simply Love software... Pictures include Feb 2026.
findings.note: East Gwillimbury Cineplex Xscape. Former DDR SuperNOVA 2 removed; ITG2 remains. Maps to other. Recent Feb 2026 photo on ZIv.

findings.name: Silverball Games @ Staggers Pub & Grub
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Asteroids; Donkey Kong; Frogger; Galaga; Pac-Man; Street Fighter; Supersonic; The Simpsons Arcade Game. No music games.
findings.note: Dartmouth NS barcade partnership. Classic cabinets only. Silverball also operates other Halifax sites; do not merge inventories.

findings.name: Skate & Play
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Dance Central 3 (International); Guitar Hero Arcade (International). An indoor roller skating rink with an arcade!
findings.note: Ottawa Baxter Rd roller rink. Dance Central 3 and Guitar Hero Arcade are rhythm titles not in the dedicated slug list, so other. Social posts also show GH play. Conditions unknown on ZIv.

findings.name: Skylon Tower
findings.evidence_quote: The base of the tower has a rather large arcade, mostly retro games... Every BEMANI games has been rid. Comments (historical): I looked around the whole place and didn't see DDR anywhere.
findings.note: Niagara Falls. Positive statement that all Bemani music games are gone. Arcade still open 2026 (arcade-museum forum / skylon.com). Remaining list is retro racers/shooters/fighters.

findings.name: Sparkles Family Entertainment
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Location: Near the back corner Comment: 3 tokens per play. Information: Used to be located in a nearby mall, it had DDR extreme and then ITG2 (Circa 2009). New Location used to have DDR Extreme (Circa 2015).
findings.note: Stellarton NS. GH Arcade last logged 2022; past DDR/ITG noted as historical only. No 2024-2026 reconfirmation found. Mark unverified.

findings.name: Sparkles Family Entertainment // Mayflower Mall
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Big Bass Wheel Pro; Claw Machine; Doodle Jump Arcade; Fruit Ninja FX; Hockey Table; Hurricane Simulator; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Skeeball; SpongeBob SquarePants Ticket Boom!; Terminator Salvation. No music games.
findings.note: Sydney/Grand Lake Road NS Mayflower Mall. Still referenced as mall arcade in 2026 social posts. FEC/redemption only on ZIv; no GH unlike Stellarton sister.

findings.name: Spin-it Records and Video
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs are pinball/classics (AC/DC Premium, Aerosmith, Metallica, Asteroids, TRON, etc.) plus Stacker. No music/rhythm games. Store still sells vinyl/video (spin-itrecords.ca).
findings.note: Moncton record shop with free-play pinball floor. Pinball Map activity confirms pinballs rotate; no rhythm cabs reported.

findings.name: Splitsville (Kanata)

No music games.
findings.note: New Ottawa-area bowling chain site. Redemption/racing only.

findings.name: Splitsville (Nanaimo)
findings.evidence_quote: Splitsville Nanaimo has an arcade that mainly consists of redemption games, with a few traditional games. There was a Guitar Hero Arcade machine at one point, but it no longer seems to be there. There is also no sign of any dance game being available in recent years.
findings.note: Positive evidence GH removed and no dance games. Current list is FEC/racing only.

findings.name: Splitsville (Richmond Hill)

No music games.
findings.note: Richmond Hill bowling FEC. No rhythm titles on ZIv or chain games page.

findings.note: Hamilton-area drive-in concession arcade with a single shooter listed.

findings.name: Stillwell Bar

findings.note: Halifax bar with pinball only on ZIv.

findings.name: Super Bowl

findings.note: Lower Sackville NS bowling. Minimal non-rhythm inventory.
